newsitem.title: UK: De La Rue Q1 operating profit below last yr.
newsitem.headline: De La Rue Q1 operating profit below last yr.

text.p: British banknote printer and security products firm De La Rue Plc said on Wednesday group operating profits in the first quarter were lower than in the same period last year.
It cited the continuing strength of sterling and margin pressure in banknotes for the pressure on Q1 profits.
"However, these effects should be offset by sales of new products within the cash systems division in the second half of the year," the company told the annual general meeting.
"Our principal associated companies, De La Rue Giori and Camelot, are performing well," it added.
